卢卡对父母没有什么印象，只记得小时候贫民窟的孩子都喊他怪胎，因为他天生怪力，胃口也是常人的十倍。
Lucca barely remembers his parents, but he does remember the children in the slums mocking him, calling him a freak due to his unnatural strength and enormous appetite.
卢卡不记得什么时候时候开始挥拳，但他记得住每一双从嘲讽轻视变成恐惧的眼睛。渐渐地，他们对他的称呼，也从怪胎变成怪物。
Lucca doesn't remember when he first started throwing punches, but he recalls every pair of eyes that shifted from mockery to fear. Over time, they started calling him a monster instead of a freak.
因为在贫民窟地下拳场长大，战斗和警惕的意志根植在卢卡的身躯和脑海中，他几乎能第一时间识别跟踪和埋伏，然后准确地判断下一步该做什么。
Raised in the underground fighting rings, Lucca's body and mind have adapted to sense danger. He can detect ambushes and when he's being tailed and always reacts accordingly with precision.
卢卡很少看医生，他身上的伤几乎都是他自己处理的，久伤成医，平时血薇帮的兄弟有个小病小痛，也会来找他处理。
Lucca rarely visits doctors. He treats nearly all of his wounds himself. After years of self-care, he's become capable enough that the other Whispers come to him for minor issues.
卢卡信奉有恩必报，有仇必还。他看不起卑劣的小人和虚伪的绅士，也厌恶和这样的人打交道。
Lucca's creed is simple: repay favors and exact vengeance. He holds no respect for hypocrites or scoundrels and loathes associating with them.
卢卡从不幻想别的可能性，命运给了他什么，他就接住什么。如果是困难，那就击碎。
Lucca doesn't entertain fantasies about other possibilities. He takes whatever fate hands him and, if necessary, shatters any difficulties in his path.
卢卡身上的伤疤大都是在地下拳场挨的，只有脸上那几道深刻的新疤，是他决定跟索尼娅来到地上时自己划的。他用这种方式斩断过去。
Lucca got most of his scars in the fighting pits, but the deep ones on his face were cut by his own hand when he chose to leave with Sonja, a symbolic act of breaking with the past.
卓越的拳技不仅得益于卢卡的天赋，还有他日复一日的苦练。他近乎自虐般执行着严苛的健身训练计划，以确保自己在战场上不留遗憾。

Lucca's exceptional boxing comes not only from his innate talent but also from years of grueling, daily practice. His harsh and almost self-destructive training regime guarantees he won't have any regrets on the battlefield.
绝对不会有人想到，血薇帮二当家，地下拳王卢卡，居然嗜甜！而且他还曾因为吃多了糖牙疼，被索尼娅勒令去看医生。
Who would have thought that Lucca, the second-in-command of the Carmine Whispers, is addicted to sweets? Once, after eating too much candy, Sonja had to make him go to the doctor for a toothache.
有人会讽刺卢卡是索尼娅的走狗，卢卡对此不以为意。他对救过自己的索尼娅献上了绝对忠诚。
Some quietly mock Lucca as Sonja's lapdog, but he ignores their jeers. He will always be loyal to the woman who saved his life.

Odie's my name. Nice to meet you!
